paper.title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
paper.central_claim: EmbodiedSWE-Bench 测试 coding agent 的长时程灵巧机器人解题，工具促进求解并迁移已验证方案；EmbodiedSWE-Gen 将方案扩展为多样教师轨迹训练 VLA，并声称 sim-to-real。
